tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rta mgrin dang tse'u dmar po zung 'brel mchod phreng don 'dus dgos tshang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+ma he ru kā la/ dpal ldan rta mchog bla mar 'dud/ /de sprul gnod sbyin tse'u dmar/ /mchod phreng sbyor dngos rjes rim rnams/ /nyung ngur spel lo gnang ba stsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rta mgrin sogs/ /yi dam gnod spyin mched bdun gyi/ /bris 'bur rten drung stegs kyi khar/ /zangs sder la sogs snod bzang du/ /phye gtsang chos sman mar khrag las/ /sbrus pa'i dpal gtor stod zur gsum/ /smad zlum mtheb skyu brgya rtsa sogs/ /gtor ma'i phyed non khrag smug sogs/ /rtsis bsgyur sha mar rgyan ci mdzes/ /mda' dar dmar pos brgyan pa dang / /gang 'dra'i snod du gnod sbyin gtor/ /gru gsum zur rtse rno nyams can/ /che ba gcig la de yi phyed/ /zin pa chung ba drug gis bskor/ /mtheb rtsi rgyan mda' bcas gang ltar/ /yungs dkar gong bu tho re ba/ /mda' sgro 'ug pa'i spu yis brgyan/ /sman g.yas khrag g.yon chu gnyis dang / /nyer mchod lnga dang chang ban la/ /mar gyi ze bsgron dkar mo lag /phye mar spos dkar mkhan dud sogs/ /rnga rol bye brag ci 'byor ro/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs skyabs kun la/ /bdag 'gro byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyabs su mchi zhing sems can don/ /lha sgom mchod phrin thabs mkhas kyi/ /phrin las bzhi dang mchog gi 'bras/ /myur du 'grub par sems bskyed do/ /chos dbyings ngang las pad nyi zla/ /sbrul gzugs gdan steng rang rig hrīḥ /dmar 'od don gnyis lhun grub 'dus/ /rang nyid rta mgrin sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gsum g.yas ljang g.yon dkar dbus/ /dmar po spyan gsum zhal gdangs shing / /mche gtsigs ljags 'dril sma smin skra/ /kham pa gyen brdzes rta mgo ni/ /ljang zhur rnam gsum rta skad 'tsher/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ gri/

/g.yon gsum sdigs mdung rgyu zhags can/ /zhabs brgyad klu brgyad steng du bgrad/ /me dpung 'bar bar stong gsum gang / /rang 'dra'i ba spu'i bu ga gtams/ /zhal nas sngags sgrog nad gdon bsregs/ /oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus/ sman gtor rak+ta mchod rdzas kun/ /bsregs sbyangs snod bcud dag pa'i rdzas/ /bde chen rol pa'i rang mdangs 'dis/ /yi dam bstan srung dges bskyed gyur/ /hrīḥspros bral dbyings las thugs rje'i mdangs/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin yi dam lha/ /bka' nyan dregs byed tse'u dmar/ /sku mdog dmar ljang srin po'i gzugs/ /btsan chas g.yas zhags dgra bgegs 'ching / /g.yon mdung de yi snying la gzir/ /rta mchog ngang pa glog 'khyug chibs/ /rus drod chu sha dbugs khrag las/ /sku lha dmar rje klu grib dang / /bdud grib btsan rgod rnam drug kyang / /rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan chas/ /so so'i 'khor bcas gnas gsum du/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshan rang nyid kyis/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs gyur/ /kyai dgongs shig bla ma rta mgrin dpal/ /phrin las dregs pa'i tse'u dmar/ /mched 'khor 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs/ /sman raka gtor mar dgyes dgur rol/ /oṃ ha yaṃ gh+ri wa yak+ṣa rā dza sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi ā pa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling ta pū dza ho/ kyai yi dam bstan srung rnams rol kun/ /phyi mchod mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod/ /nang mchod bde chen sprin phung 'khrigs/ /gsang mchod gnyis med zung 'jug bzhes/ /oṃ ha yaṃ sogs nas sa pā ri wā ra bar 'dra/ pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ kyai yi dam bstan srung 'khor bcas drung / /bcas rang nyes kun mthol zhing bshags/ /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bstan 'gror 'phral yun dngos grub stsol/ /rta mgrin sngags gong bzhin gyi 'go gnon bcas/ btsan bskul gyi sngags ni/

oṃ rak+sha rak+sha snying la hūm̐ hūm̐/ shū la gh+rī ba triḥshū la hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥzhes ci 'grub/ kyai dbang gi las mdzad rta mgrin dpal/ /gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar/ /mched drug 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /grub gnyis rab myur khyed la bstod/ /kyai gsol lo mchod do dam tshig rdzas/ /rang rang thugs smon ji bzhin du/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgya las byung 'dis/ /thams cad thugs dam skong gyur cig /kyai dge legs chos dbyings mkha' klong nas/ /'gag med gzugs sku'i phrin las kyis/ /bstan 'gro'i pad tshal rab bzhad de/ /phan bde'i sbrang rtsi dar brtan shog /ces 'di rnam 'dren rgyal dbang rje/ /'jam dpal rgya mtsho dgyes rdzas su/ /lhag bsam can gyi sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun blos phul ba dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rta mgrin dang tsi'u dmar po zung 'brel mchod phreng / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
